newsitem.title: USA: NIPSCO 361 MW Ind. coal unit seen back Thurs.
newsitem.headline: NIPSCO 361 MW Ind. coal unit seen back Thurs.

text.p: Northern Indiana Public Service Co's 361 megawatt coal unit 18 at its Schahfer generating station was expected to resume output on Thursday, a company spokeswoman said.
The unit, located in northwest Indiana, was shut Jan 3 for maintenance work for an expected seven weeks, the spokeswoman said.

Also, Northern Indiana's 160 megawatt unit 7 at the Bailly generating station in Indiana was expected to be down about three weeks for maintenance work after being taken off line Feb 21, the spokeswoman said.
Northern Indiana Public is a subsidiary of NIPSCO Industries Inc.
